instruction:
Answer the following question using web search and research tools:

Of the two wonders of the ancient world that were statues, how much shorter was the taller of the two compared to the tallest statue in Japan as of 2024?
stdout:
The two wonders of the ancient world that were statues are:

1. **Colossus of Rhodes** — ~33 meters (108 feet) tall
2. **Statue of Zeus at Olympia** — ~6.7 meters (22 feet) tall (seated figure)

The taller of the two is the **Colossus of Rhodes** at approximately **33 meters**.

The tallest statue in Japan as of 2024 is the **Ushiku Daibutsu** in Ibaraki Prefecture at **120 meters** tall [Ushiku Daibutsu - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ushiku_Daibutsu) [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/photos/asia/3277925/japans-120-metre-tall-giant-buddha-statue-gets-its-annual-clean).

---

**Calculation:**

| Statute | Height |
|---|---|
| Ushiku Daibutsu (Japan, tallest) | 120 m |
| Colossus of Rhodes (taller ancient wonder) | 33 m |
| **Difference** | **87 m** |

The taller of the two ancient wonder statues (the Colossus of Rhodes) was approximately **87 meters (282 feet)** shorter than the Ushiku Daibutsu in Japan.
